# Load Packages
```{r,warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DECIPHER); 
library(phangorn); packageVersion("phangorn")

library(picante); packageVersion("picante")

library(ape); packageVersion("ape")

```

#Load in a tree
```{r,warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
tree<-phytools::read.newick("denovo_treeWNovSamples.nwk")
PatristicDistMatrix<-cophenetic.phylo(tree)

```

## Ultrametric Tree
```{r,warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# load tree
#load("new_tree.rds")
tree<-phytools::read.newick("denovo_treeWNovSamples.nwk")
tree_ultra = phytools::force.ultrametric(tree)
is.ultrametric(tree_ultra) #TRUE

```

##Graphing Trees
```{r}
ggtree(tree_ultra) + 
geom_tiplab(offset=0.02, geom= "text",size=2)+
geom_nodelab(size =2 , col= "red",hjust=1)+
geom_treescale(y=10, color='black', linesize=1, offset=3) +
xlim(0,2)

```

## Phylogenetic Distance Matrix
```{r, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Create a Phylogenetic Resemblance Matrix
phydist <- cophenetic.phylo(tree_ultra)
phydist2 <- cophenetic.phylo(tree)

#Is the cophenetic distances euclidean?
phydist.dist <- as.dist(phydist)
ade4::is.euclid(phydist.dist) #TRUE

phydist.dist2 <- as.dist(phydist2)
ade4::is.euclid(phydist.dist2) #FALSE
sqrt.phylo.dist <- sqrt(phydist2)
phydist.dist2 <- as.dist(sqrt.phylo.dist)
ade4::is.euclid(phydist.dist2) #TRUE - fixed!

save(phydist, file="phydist_2023_12_12.rds")

```

Some Possible Combinations of 10 Fungi, pool includes 42 fungi, all possible combinations of 10 would be 3190187286 and this crashes R, therefore we will use a for loop to randomly sample to make communities of 10 instead
```{r}
# make vector of isolate names
fungi <- unique(colnames(phydist.sub2))

fungi<-as.data.frame(fungi)
#fungi$fungi<as.vector(fungi)

# Set the number of repetitions
num_repetitions <- 100000

# Create a matrix to store the results
result_matrix <- matrix(nrow = num_repetitions, ncol = 10)

# Repeat the process 50 times
for (i in 1:num_repetitions) {
  # Sample values from the 'Value' column
  sampled_values <- sample(fungi$fungi, 10, replace = FALSE)
  
  # Store the sampled values in the result matrix
  result_matrix[i, ] <- sampled_values
}

# Convert the result matrix to a data frame if needed
result_df <- as.data.frame(result_matrix)

# Display the result
View(result_df)

#library(combinat)
#combinations of 9 fungi, no repeating within group
#comms <- as.data.frame(combn(fungi, 10))

#Calculate percentage of matches between communities, remove communities that match others with greater than 40% of the community (4/10), This step takes some time.

# Create an empty vector to store column names for removal
result_df<-t(result_df)
# random select 10000 combinations
comms2 <-result_df[1:10, sample(ncol(result_df), 10000)]
comms2<-as.data.frame(comms2)
columns_to_remove <- c()
threshold<-0.4
# Loop through each column
for (i in 1:(ncol(comms2) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(comms2)) {
    # Calculate the match percentage
    match_percentage <- mean(comms2[, i] == comms2[, j])
    
    # If the match percentage exceeds the threshold, mark the column for removal
    if (match_percentage >= threshold) {
      if (!(names(comms2)[i] %in% columns_to_remove)) {
        columns_to_remove <- c(columns_to_remove, names(comms2)[i])
      }
      if (!(names(comms2)[j] %in% columns_to_remove)) {
        columns_to_remove <- c(columns_to_remove, names(comms2)[j])
      }
    }
  }
}

 # Remove the marked columns from the data frame
`%ni%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
comms3<-subset(comms2,select = names(comms2) %ni% columns_to_remove)

```

# Community Phylogenetic Distances
```{r}
# create each distance matrix for communities and calculate the average dissimilarity
combo4.phy_avg = list()
for (i in 1:ncol(comms3)){
  phy.matrix = phydist.sub[c(comms3[,i]),c(comms3[,i])]
  combo4.phy_avg[i] = mean(phy.matrix[upper.tri(phy.matrix)])
}

# create each distance matrix for communities and calculate the standard deviation of dissimilarity
combo4.phy_std = list()
for (i in 1:ncol(comms3)){
  phy.matrix = phydist.sub[c(comms3[,i]),c(comms3[,i])]
  combo4.phy_std[i] = sd(phy.matrix[upper.tri(phy.matrix)])
}

# look at min, max, median of the phylo distance avg and std deviation for the communities
Reduce(min, combo4.phy_std)
Reduce(max, combo4.phy_std)
Reduce(median, combo4.phy_std)

Reduce(min, combo4.phy_avg)
Reduce(max, combo4.phy_avg)
Reduce(median, combo4.phy_avg)

```

# Plot Community Dissimilarity

## Phylogenetic Distance
```{r}
pd_avg <- unlist(combo4.phy_avg)
pd_std <- unlist(combo4.phy_std)

pd_plotdata <- cbind(pd_avg, pd_std)
pd_plotdata <- as.data.frame(pd_plotdata)

pd_plot<-ggplot(data= pd_plotdata, aes(x=row.names(pd_plotdata), y=pd_avg))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Community")+ylab("Phylogenetic Distance")
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = pd_avg-pd_std, ymax = pd_avg+pd_std))

pd_plot

#pdf("ave_phylodist_12_13_2023.pdf")
#pd_plot
#dev.off()

#Remove communities that don't contain pioneers

to_keep <- c("n19323","n19298","n19590","n16704","n11659")
comms3.5<-t(comms3)
comms3.5<-as.data.frame(comms3.5)
`%ni%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
comms4<-subset(comms3.5,select=names(comms3.5) %ni% to_keep)


```

# Put together data frame of isolates + phylo data
```{r}
TreatComb4.TreatCombo4 = list()
for (i in 1:ncol(comms3)){
  TreatComb4.TreatCombo4[i] = as.data.frame(list(comms3[,i]))
}

TreatComb4.TreatCombo4.df = as.data.frame(TreatComb4.TreatCombo4, col.names = 1:length(TreatComb4.TreatCombo4))
TreatComb4.df.t = as.data.frame(t(TreatComb4.TreatCombo4.df))
colnames(TreatComb4.df.t) = c("Isol_1", "Isol_2", "Isol_3", "Isol_4","Isol_5","Isol_6","Isol_7","Isol_8","Isol_9","Isol_10")
row.names(TreatComb4.df.t) = row.names(pd_std)

df4 = cbind(pd_avg, pd_std, TreatComb4.df.t)
```

# Random Selection
```{r}

#Bin communities into 3 phylogenetic categories Low (0.04934741-0.10),medium(0.11-0.15),high(0.16-0.2012841)

df5 <- df4 %>%
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    pd_avg >= 0.04 & pd_avg < 0.11 ~ "Low",
    pd_avg >= 0.12 & pd_avg < 0.135 ~ "Medium",
    pd_avg >= 0.149 ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

#Randomly select 50 communities that contain the pioneers, chose the first that are in the high medium or low bin
```

```{r}
#Some Possible Combinations of 4 Fungi, pool includes 41 fungi, all possible combinations of 4 would be 101270 and this does not crash R and therefore can do all of them

# make vector of isolate names
fungi <- unique(colnames(phydist.sub2))

fungi<-as.data.frame(fungi)
#fungi$fungi<as.vector(fungi)

# Set the number of repetitions
num_repetitions <- 101270

# Create a matrix to store the results
result_matrix_low <- matrix(nrow = num_repetitions, ncol = 4)

# Repeat the process
for (i in 1:num_repetitions) {
  # Sample values from the 'Value' column
  sampled_values <- sample(fungi$fungi, 4, replace = FALSE)
  
  # Store the sampled values in the result matrix
  result_matrix_low[i, ] <- sampled_values
}

# Convert the result matrix to a data frame if needed
result_df_low <- as.data.frame(result_matrix_low)

# Display the result
View(result_df_low)


##Decided not to do this step and when final communities are chosen just avoid those that contain similar/same community members
#Calculate percentage of matches between communities, remove communities that match others with greater than 40% of the community (4/10), This step takes some time.

# Create an empty vector to store column names for removal
result_df_low<-t(result_df_low)

comms2 <-result_df_low[1:4, sample(ncol(result_df_low), 101270)]
comms2<-as.data.frame(result_df_low)

columns_to_remove <- c()
threshold<-0.4
# Loop through each column
for (i in 1:(ncol(comms2) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(comms2)) {
    # Calculate the match percentage
    match_percentage <- mean(comms2[, i] == comms2[, j])
    
    # If the match percentage exceeds the threshold, mark the column for removal
    if (match_percentage >= threshold) {
      if (!(names(comms2)[i] %in% columns_to_remove)) {
        columns_to_remove <- c(columns_to_remove, names(comms2)[i])
      }
      if (!(names(comms2)[j] %in% columns_to_remove)) {
        columns_to_remove <- c(columns_to_remove, names(comms2)[j])
      }
    }
  }
}

 # Remove the marked columns from the data frame
`%ni%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
comms3<-subset(comms2,select = names(comms2) %ni% columns_to_remove)

#Remove communities that don't contain pioneers

to_keep <- c("n19323","n19298","n19590","n16704","n11659")
comms3.5<-t(comms2)
comms3.5<-t(comms3.5)
comms3.5<-as.data.frame(comms3.5)
comms4 <- comms3.5 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  filter(any(c(V1,V2,V3,V4) %in% to_keep))

# create each distance matrix for communities and calculate the average dissimilarity
comms4<-t(comms4)
combo4.phy_avg = list()

for (i in 1:ncol(comms4)){
  phy.matrix = phydist.sub[c(comms4[,i]),c(comms4[,i])]
  combo4.phy_avg[i] = mean(phy.matrix[upper.tri(phy.matrix)])
}

# create each distance matrix for communities and calculate the standard deviation of dissimilarity
combo4.phy_std = list()
for (i in 1:ncol(comms4)){
  phy.matrix = phydist.sub[c(comms4[,i]),c(comms4[,i])]
  combo4.phy_std[i] = sd(phy.matrix[upper.tri(phy.matrix)])
}

# look at min, max, median of the phylo distance avg and std deviation for the communities
Reduce(min, combo4.phy_std)
Reduce(max, combo4.phy_std)
Reduce(median, combo4.phy_std)

Reduce(min, combo4.phy_avg)
Reduce(max, combo4.phy_avg)
Reduce(median, combo4.phy_avg)

#plot average distances

pd_std <- unlist(combo4.phy_std)

pd_plotdata <- cbind(pd_avg, pd_std)
pd_plotdata <- as.data.frame(pd_plotdata)

pd_plot<-ggplot(data= pd_plotdata, aes(x=row.names(pd_plotdata), y=pd_avg))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Community")+ylab("Phylogenetic Distance")
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = pd_avg-pd_std, ymax = pd_avg+pd_std))

pd_plot
```
